items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Ray Baudac is mentioned by the Interviewer as an example of a drummer from the past whose albums young kids might listen to; the Interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote or confirmation of a relationship.

ctx.x: Yes, it's on that, that's the principle of it and you tell them that, of course some of them are very open minded and they appreciate the things. A lot of these young kids, they don't like a lot of these modern drummers, you know, they'll go way back and get some of Gene Krupa's

albums, Ray McKinley, Ray Baudac, go back and get some of those things, Jo Jones, they like that style. A lot of those young drummers don't like a Max Roach or Elvin Jones or like that you know. Some of them do, you know, but a lot of them don't.

There seems to have been a revival in the past few years. A lot of the players who came up, you know, before bebop and who were kind of neglected for a number of years, like Arnett Cobb. Is working a lot again.
